name: MindEase
tagline: A private, early-support companion for student mental wellbeing
problem: Exam stress, anxiety and low mood in students often go unnoticed
Stigma stops students from walking into the counselling room
Counsellors get no early signal until a crisis
Help-seeking info is hard to find at the moment it's needed

stats.label: student suicides a year in India (NCRB ADSI 2021-22, approx.)
treatment gap for mental disorders in India (NMHS 2015-16)
mental health conditions begin by age 14 (WHO)

solution: Private daily journal plus PHQ-9 / GAD-7 check-ins, in English and Tanglish
Explainable engine notices dips vs your own baseline, kindly
Instant support screen with Tele-MANAS 14416 and 112 when risk words appear
Counsellors see only opt-in, pseudonymous aggregates and alerts

features.title: PHQ-9 & GAD-7
features.desc: Standard wording and bands; item 9 > 0 opens a support screen at once

features.title: Explainable journal
features.desc: Lexicon sentiment with negation, emoji, Tanglish; shows why, never diagnoses

features.title: Personal trends
features.desc: CUSUM + dip run vs your usual: 'your mood has dipped for 5 days'

features.title: Offline toolkit
features.desc: Box breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, Pomodoro exam planner, sleep tips

features.title: Prepare to talk
features.desc: Turns a few taps into words to say to a friend, parent or counsellor

features.title: Counsellor view
features.desc: Opt-in pseudonymous aggregates, small-cell suppression, alert follow-up

architecture: Browser UI (vanilla JS, inline SVG) -> student and counsellor views
app.py ThreadingHTTPServer -> JSON API, demo PIN role check
questionnaires.py -> PHQ-9 / GAD-7 scoring, bands, item-9 rule
sentiment.py + safety.py -> tone, emotions, concerning phrases
trends.py -> rolling means, CUSUM, dip run, OLS slope
counsellor.py -> weekly bands, suppression, alert workflow
algorithms: PHQ-9 / GAD-7 – published 0-3 scoring and severity bands
Lexicon sentiment – valence, negation, intensifiers, 'but', emoji
Safety net – 41 phrase rules + first-person co-occurrence layer
One-sided CUSUM – small persistent dips vs personal baseline
OLS slope t-test – supporting trend evidence
Greedy Pomodoro allocation – need x urgency, sleep protected
innovation: Safety-first: crisis help one tap away on every screen
Explainable, offline, no cloud: journal never leaves the laptop
Understands Tanglish and emoji the way students actually write
Early signal for counsellors without surveillance

results.label: direct risk phrases caught, 0/22 false alarms; 8/10 indirect
